change: Create an ordinary unauthenticated vendor peer for eligible early PASN Auth1 before calling original validation, adapted from reference GREEN2_NAN_AUTH_PEER_FIX.

coverage: native rejection and return value preserved

limitations: No real early-Auth1/missing-peer case occurred in these captures (early_peer_created=0). The new branch is covered by native tests and verified in the linked image, but recovery on this hardware is not demonstrated by these runs.
The phone already had a completed 100/100 reconnect report before this patch. Do not attribute 35/35 here versus the older 18/20 report to a measured reliability improvement.
Cold ready times remain several seconds; no sub-second cold-start guarantee.
One CoreDevice launch failed to obtain a process ID and one was denied because the device was locked. Neither started a connection test; after the user requested retry, testing succeeded.
Only current AP heap samples and software queue-drop counters are measured. These are not a true minimum heap or proof of zero RF loss/TCP retransmissions.
Original archive, radio settings, bulk buffers, task priorities, 10-second heap logging and app source are unchanged. No new throughput gain is claimed.
